|errata_history=This card has one published text. The images are the Virtual Block 8.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-There_Is_Another.png]], the first printing) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VSh-L-thereisanother-pre.gif]]); both print it.
* First printed in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), Light Side p. 7, page 6, slip 31 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless you have deployed a Skywalker this game, plays on table. "Luke" and "Son Of Vader" on opponent's [Death Star II] cards are treated as "Leia" and "Lady Vader," respectively. Once during your turn, opponent may activate 1 Force.”
* The Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet (21 May 2013)<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=6 Players Committee Virtual Shields sheet] (Defensive Shield pages of the Virtual Cards Master List, PDF made 21 May 2013), PDF page 6, slip 46 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the same text ([[:File:VL-history-1200-11-shield-master.png]]); so does the Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 18)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=18 Internet Archive]</ref>.
* The PC website card list (Virtual Block 8 and Virtual Master lists, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013) shows “Unless you have deployed a Skywalker this game, plays on Table. 'Luke' and 'Son of Vader' on opponent's (Death Star II) cards are treated as 'Leia'and 'Lady Vader,' respectively. Once during your turn, opponent may activate 1 Force.”<ref name="cl-1200_11-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in every capture to 11 January 2013</ref> It writes the icon as “(Death Star II)” and differs otherwise only in capitals and spacing (“Table”, “Son of”, “'Leia'and”).
